panels.title: Raumtemperatur jetzt
panels.description: Pro Home-Assistant-Bereich der Mittelwert der aktuellen Raumsensoren (device_class temperature); ein Raum nur mit Thermostaten zeigt deren Messwert. Der Außenbereich (Variable outdoor_room) fehlt hier.

targets.query:
latest = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "graphyard_metrics" and r._field == "value" and r.source_system == "homeassistant" and r.subject_type == "environment_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.device_class and r.device_class == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not (exists r.measurement_kind and r.measurement_kind == "setpoint"))
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, room: if exists r.area then r.area else "Ohne Raum", thermostat: exists r.device_role and r.device_role == "thermostat"}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.room != "${outdoor_room}")
// Room sensors first; a room with only thermostats shows their mean.
sensors = latest
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not r.thermostat)
  |> group(columns: ["room"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({room: r.room, _value: r._value, rank: 1}))
thermostats = latest
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thermostat)
  |> group(columns: ["room"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({room: r.room, _value: r._value, rank: 2}))
union(tables: [sensors, thermostats])
  |> group(columns: ["room"])
  |> sort(columns: ["rank"])
  |> first()
  |> keep(columns: ["room", "_value"])

panels.title: Luftfeuchte nach Raum
panels.description: Mittel der Feuchtesensoren (device_class humidity) je Home-Assistant-Bereich.

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "graphyard_metrics" and r._field == "value" and r.source_system == "homeassistant" and r.subject_type == "environment_sensor")
// Latest friendly name and Home Assistant area per entity: a rename or a new area changes the legend and the room, never the series (entity_id).
meta = base
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({entity_id: r.entity_id, name: if exists r.friendly_name then r.friendly_name else r.entity_id, room: if exists r.area then r.area else "Ohne Raum"}))
series = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.device_class and r.device_class == "humidity")
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
join(tables: {s: series, m: meta}, on: ["entity_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.room != "${outdoor_room}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, room: r.room}))
  |> group(columns: ["room", "_time"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["room"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "graphyard_metrics" and r._field == "value" and r.source_system == "homeassistant" and r.subject_type == "environment_sensor")
// Latest friendly name and Home Assistant area per entity: a rename or a new area changes the legend and the room, never the series (entity_id).
meta = base
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({entity_id: r.entity_id, name: if exists r.friendly_name then r.friendly_name else r.entity_id, room: if exists r.area then r.area else "Ohne Raum"}))
t0 = join(tables: {s: base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => (exists r.device_class and r.device_class == "temperature") and not (exists r.measurement_kind and r.measurement_kind == "setpoint"))
    |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false), m: meta}, on: ["entity_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, entity_id: r.entity_id, room: r.room, name: r.name}))
t1 = join(tables: {s: base
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.measurement_kind and r.measurement_kind == "setpoint")
    |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false), m: meta}, on: ["entity_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, entity_id: r.entity_id, room: r.room, name: r.name + " (Soll)"}))
union(tables: [t0, t1])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.room =~ /^${room:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id", "name"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
